tags.bug: ☀️ Fixed an issue where the game would consume excessive memory and freeze when paused and left running for an extended period.

☀️ Fixed a bug where quickly placing a launchpad while moving the mouse could cause the placement to fail while still subtracting tech points and credits. This could lead to softlocks and occurred more frequently on lower-FPS PCs and Steam Deck.
☀️ [b]Sector 03.1:[/b] Fixed ceramic not displaying a recipe in the wiki when playing this sector before Sector 04.
☀️ Fixed audio clips cutting off prematurely when fast-forwarding game speed.
☀️ Fixed custom key rebinds only initializing after opening the rebinding screen instead of loading automatically.
Fixed the rebind button not reverting to its default label when starting a different rebind process, which effectively canceled the current one.
☀️ Added a stick deadzone to prevent drifting on connected gamepads, which caused the asteroid to keep rotating.
☀️ Fixed the "Edge Rotation Enabled" setting reverting to its default value after restarting the game.

tags.feature: ☀️ Added a progress bar for most achievements — either counting down (e.g., for the Space Falcon challenge) or counting up.
☀️ Disabled "Achievement Missed" notifications if the achievement has already been unlocked.
Added a “missed” visual state (semi-transparent) to achievement badges.

tags.balance_change: ☀️ [b]Sector 05:[/b] Improved consistency of Hard Melting remaining ice area calculation. (Note: Ice can still spawn under craters, preventing the achievement from triggering — check the progress bar to confirm.)

tags.feature: ☀️ Implemented autosave at fixed intervals: the game now saves automatically when switching scenes if 3 minutes have passed, and after 6 minutes if staying in the same scene. This can be disabled in the settings menu.
☀️ Added descriptions to most resource and building wiki entries.
☀️ Improved performance when drawing very long rover paths.
☀️ When syncing game data with Steam Cloud, the game no longer considers it a first launch on a new PC (which would play the prologue cutscene and restart Level 01) if save data already exists.
☀️ [b]Sector 01:[/b] Stats screen and score tooltip are now accessible before completing the sector.
[b]Sector 01:[/b] The Intro cutscene no longer plays every time  when restarting the sector after completing it once.
[b]Sector 05:[/b] Removed inaccessible small craters from plateaus to avoid confusion.

tags.bug: ☀️ Rover no longer moves while the game is paused.

tags.feature: ☀️ Added a game resolution setting to the cutscene skip menu.

☀️ When a Strangelet is excavated (last excavation quest fulfilled), it now disappears from the asteroid and the excavation hub performing the excavation is destroyed, making it clear that the hub is no longer active.

tags.bug: Pause the cutscene playback while the cutscene skip menu is open.

tags.feature: Added social buttons to the credits screen for kurzgesagt’s Bluesky and TikTok profiles.

notes.title: Star Birds: Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
[b]The Star Birds Demo is out now. Play Star Birds today and join us during Steam Next Fest.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/61b1d3ba95919afc3991dc9d1aa7fc0ff132ea9c.png[/img]

The Star Birds Demo is waiting for you. After internal playtests in Q1, we are now looking for your feedback. As we are a small indie dev team of 8 people, we are only launching on one platform for the time being. If there is demand from the community, further ports will follow after the official release.

[b]👉 Platform: Windows
💻 Device: PC 
🗨 Languages: Demo Available in 12 Languages
🕖 Scope: Tutorial 1, Tutorial 2, Expedition Level[/b]

Get a feel for whether Star Birds could be the right game for you. And if so, look forward to more content later this year.

[h3]Demo Scope: What to Expect
[/h3]

The [b]official Star Birds demo gives you a sneak-peek[/b] into the gameplay and campaign that awaits you in the Early Access release of the game launching later this year.
It features the [b]first two campaign levels[/b], and infinitely replayable and procedurally generated [b]bonus Expedition Level[/b] where you can hone and further develop your sklills on your own.
By playing this level you'll get a glimpse of more content and complexity awaiting you in the release version.

As an indie team we see the demo as a great chance to receive first hand player feedback from you!
We want to develop Star Birds closely with the community and welcome your messages, feedback and bug reports here in the Steam Community Hub or in our Discord.
Now it’s your turn, we hope you enjoy!

💁‍♀️ Included in the Demo (June 2025):
[list]
[*] [b]Central Game Loop[/b] - Build production facilities and mine resources.
[*] [b]Establish Production Chains [/b]- Optimize your space factory and set up interplanetary transportation lines.
[*] [b]Meet the Crew[/b] - Jump into the Star Birds story campaign and go on an adventure with the birbs.
[*] [b]Gameplay Tutorial[/b] - New to the factory building genre? We've got you. The Demo can be played by experienced players and curious beginners alike.
[*] [b]Challenge Level[/b] - to test your acquired space mining skills and compare to other players.
[/list]

🙅‍♂️ [b][u]Not [/u][/b]Included in the Demo:
[list]
[*] Full Story Experience - The Demo will include the beginning of the story campaign, many more mysteries await you in the full version.
[*] Perfectly Fine-Tuned Balancing - We need your Demo feedback, to fine-tune and optimize the game 
[*] Heaps of Resources and Buildings - The Demo provides a selection of ressources and buildings relevant to the scope of the Demo Sneak-peek.
[*] Bigger & Late-Game Challenges - Looking for more exciting missions and gameplay challenges? Find it in the final version of the game!
[/list]
The Demo is available for PC in 12 languages. Download it here on Steam. The best place to give feedback is our [url=https://discord.gg/toukana][b]Discord [/b][/url]server. There, we are running a smart ticketing system: Leave feedback, vote up change requests and bug reports from other users, and help us to prioritize tasks in the further development process of Star Birds.


[hr][/hr]

[h3]Wishlist Star Birds & Join Our Newsletter[/h3]
[i]Star Birds is an indie project by [b]Toukana Interactive[/b] and [b]kurzgesagt[/b]. We are over the moon to have such an amazing community. You are the reason why this project exists. If you want to support us, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2719750/Star_Birds/][i][b]Wishlist [/b][/i][/url]the game here on Steam, and tell your friends about it.

If you would like to be the first to read content like this and are looking for more in-depth insights, we recommend our [b]newsletter[/b] – sign up at [url=star-birds.com/nl][i][b]toukana.com/starbirds[/b][/i][/url].

notes.title: Devlog: Crew Love Is True Love
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/a820122e7ace28ec52043cc5c36278ff0e7a9291.png[/img]


[b]Today we want to introduce you to the crew. To the birds that populate the space station in Star Birds. We show you how we came up with a strong cast of characters, and how we brought the kurzgesagt birbs to a 3D universe. And not to forget their roles on board - as we will send them on a mysterious mission ...[/b]

[h3]Getting Dressed for Space 👩‍🚀[/h3]
Sure - a game called Star Birds needs spacefaring birds. Cheerful supporting characters who lead you through the story, in dialogues and campaigns. But how to recruit them? 

As a first step, we analyzed the [b]birds that we discovered in the YouTube videos together with our project partner kurzgesagt[/b]. Their body parts, their emotions, their animations. We were looking for an elegant way to equip them for their space mission. By replacing the head feathers with accessories such as pilot's caps, and their body plumage with space suits.

[/table]

[h3]Modular Bird Generation 🦉[/h3]
The next challenge was to send the 2D YouTube birds to a universe where they will become the main act of various dialogue scenes and the quest givers for the delivery missions. To do so, our teams (Toukana🤝kurzgesagt) had to create a skeleton that could be animated in our game. In Blender, we converted the SVG Vector graphics into flat mesh shapes, attached them to the skeleton and a rig and now ... they're alive! 

Finally, we added gradients and a splash of color in Unity. It was important for us to think about variation of the birds in a modular way. Easily swapping body types, shapes and colors. Internally, we call our tool the "[b]2D Bird Generator[/b]".


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/e4bfd1ccb37fd301d397ed5cf706e25be61d1d7e.png[/img]

[h3]Creating Interesting Characters 🐔[/h3]
As you will not control and play your own bird character in Star Birds, but take on a managing role, our teams had to double down on the birds supporting the gameplay and narrative, leading you through the story. One of the most difficult questions was where in the game we wanted the [b]kurzgesagt birds [/b]to appear, and where the gameplay should stand on its own.

To make the gameplay and narrative fit together, we imagined them as main charaters of the cutscenes and dialogues, operators of the buildings and machinery and quest givers. To make them interesting characters, we gave them specific professions as Scientists or Engineers, Workers, and of course last but not least - a Captain to keep every member of the crew focused on the mission... in theory ;)

You can look forward to seeing the result in Star Birds soon and meeting the bird crew! Fully clothed and commissioned. 🚀

notes.title: Star Birds Demo Lands This June!
notes.content:
[b]Star Birds will be available as a public demo. Playable for everyone from June 2025. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/f66c0bc5db583d375527ee7904f012257d64a053.png[/img]

We are going to release a demo for Star Birds! After internal playtests in Q1, we are looking for your feedback. There lies a huge value in your various gaming experiences and backgrounds as Star Birds will be a game encompassing a broad genre mix:

[b]🏭 Factory Builder
💎Mining & Resource Management
👽 Mysterious Story Campaign
😍 Relaxing & Fun Gameplay[/b]

We're on a mission to find the perfect balance.
Between easy-to-pick-up fun and rich, rewarding depth. Between laid-back sessions and immersive complex production network mastery.
This demo is just the beginning, as the game will launch into Early Access sometime this year.

[h3]Get ready to explore, experiment, and enjoy the ride.
[/h3]

This demo is designed to give you a first glimpse of the game's core experience. It's a chance to explore the gameplay, get a feel for the game flow and design, and dive into the heart of the adventure. We're looking forward to your feedback!

To keep things clear, here’s what’s ready for you now—and what’s still on the way.

💁‍♀️ Included in the Demo (June 2025):
[list]
[*] [b]Central Game Loop[/b] - Build production facilities and mine resources
[*] [b]Establish Production Chains[/b] - Optimize your space factory and set up interplanetary transportation lines
[*] [b]Meet the Crew [/b]- Jump into the Star Birds story and go on an adventure with the birbs
[*] [b]Gameplay Tutorial[/b] - New to the factory building genre? We've got you. The demo can be played by experienced players and curious beginners alike.
[*] [b]Challenge level[/b] - to test your acquired space mining skills and compare to other players
[/list]
🙅‍♂️ [u][b]Not [/b][/u]Included in the Demo:
[list]
[*] [b]Full Story Experience[/b] - The demo will just include the beginning of the story campaign, many more mysteries await you in the full version
[*] [b]Fine-Tuned Balancing[/b] - For this we need your demo feedback, there are certainly still points to optimize in the system
[*] [b]Full Content of Resources and Buildings[/b] - We will provide a selection that is relevant to the scope of the demo run
[*] [b]Bigger & Late-game Challenges[/b] - Looking for a higher level of difficulty and a mission beyond tutorial stage? Find it in the final version of the game!
[/list]

[b]The demo will be available for PC in 12 languages. Downloadable here on Steam. 

The best place for your feedback is our [url=https://discord.gg/toukana]Discord server[/url]. On Discord, we will activate an upvoting tool in June that will forward your most urgent feedback directly to the dev team.[/b] 🙌

notes.title: Devlog: Resources in Star Birds
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/ee3271487e1da04803a5e3a028584662cd770365.png[/img]

[b]Today, we're excited to unveil the first hint of cosmic bounty the solar system in Star Birds has to offer! We've cooked up our own unique "ingredient list" for the universe, packed with both familiar and fantastical resources, all wrapped in a vibrant, clean design to make gathering materials a blast.[/b]

[h3]Cosmic Cookbook - Our Recipe for Resources 🚀[/h3]
If you've ever enjoyed tinkering with building blocks, mixing potions or finding interesting item combinations, you'd have loved our initial resource brainstorm! We started with the plausible basics you'd expect to find on asteroids and in space. Then, we let our imaginations run wild, adding some truly unique "spice" to the mix. We experimented with wild combos, figuring out what awesome new materials your Star Bird colony could whip up. 

The result? A sprawling catalog of metals, gases, and even some completely made-up substances, all waiting to be discovered on asteroid surfaces and transformed into essential goodies for your thriving intergalactic bird colony.

[/table]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/5b3350eb8fe338e08380813f6b15444d0ab4f24b.png[/img]

[h3]When Water Forms a Drop 💧[/h3]
The elements needed a gestalt. We wanted to combine the flat, colorful design of kurzgesagt with the 3D look of Toukana. The resource equivalent in the game includes the resource icon - its shape and color defined by the resource category (e.g. metal, gas), the resource field on the asteroid surface (as discovered by the rover unit), and the HUD layout displaying resources - for a clear and easily readable gaming experience. Step by step, we came up with a holistic design language for the in-game resources.

[h3]Overlooking Complexity 🤓[/h3]
Finally, we adjusted the complexity level. To have more efficient test runs, we developed a tool that shows us the complexity level of a specific production chain. Answering questions such as: How many steps will it take a test player to produce a certain resource? How many units of this resource have already been mined? And if this resource is mined, what options does this open up to the player?

With our Pending Complexity Tool, the focus will increasingly shift towards balancing. Our goal: The development of well-integrated production chains for a good game flow and transparent level advancement.
